en: Sepia-toned image of a long, low pavilion-like building set in a park or garden. The structure has many windows and a deep veranda supported by decorative wooden columns. Trees and curving footpaths dominate the foreground, leading toward steps up to the veranda. The overall look is of an early 20th‑century spa, sanatorium, or summer resort building in a wooded setting. No clear caption or postal markings are visible on the front.
